# Per-package statement-coverage floors: one `<package-dir> <percent>` per
# line, the dir relative to the module root. This file is the ONE source of
# the floors. `go run ./internal/tools/citest cover-check` (make cover; CI's
# coverage job) measures a profile of BOTH test tiers against it and fails
# on any package below its floor or absent from the profile;
# TestPerPackageCoverageFloors (internal/integration) validates it
# structurally (a real package dir, 0..100, no duplicate). It is also the
# -coverpkg list: `citest cover-pkgs` prints these dirs as import paths,
# and only they are instrumented. A package's figure counts statements
# covered by ANY test in the repo, so a package tested from elsewhere
# (encoding) is measured fairly.
encoding              95
